feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: If you have the scratch, they have the scares
entry.summary: Scary stories are more than fun, they're big business.

entry.title: With an ad aimed at Trump, this Republican exposed GOP angst about Latino voters
entry.summary: Rep. María Elvira Salazar filmed an ad warning the president that he's "gone too far" on immigration. It reflected concern among some Republicans that their gains with Latino voters could be at risk.

entry.title: Major fire breaks out in Alberta after deadly incident at military base
entry.summary: Canada's defense minister said Saturday that people were killed and injured in an incident at a military base in Alberta that caused a major fire.

entry.title: Oregon governor Tina Kotek reacts to Silver Rail Elementary school shooting
entry.summary: NPR's Joel Rose talks with Oregon Governor Tina Kotek about the shooting at Silver Rail Elementary in Bend, Oregon.

entry.title: French police arrest 1,800 after violent clashes and looting mar protests
entry.summary: Police arrested at least 1,800 people across France after violent groups clashed with officers and looted shops during nationwide demonstrations that drew hundreds of thousands of people.

entry.title: Pope Leo XIV leaves hospital days after lung cancer surgery
entry.summary: The Pope left Rome's Gemelli Hospital Saturday, days after surgery for lung cancer removed the lower lobe of his right lung. He is currently scheduled to travel to Latin America in November.

entry.title: Zelenskyy urges support for new US sanctions on Russia after Trump puts them on hold
entry.summary: Zelenskyy described the move as unfortunate, adding it would encourage Russia to continue its assault. Trump told Congress that the pause was in the national interest but gave no further details.

entry.title: Perspective: Midterm money madness
entry.summary: Campaign ad spending has topped $10 billion this election cycle, as voters struggle to afford groceries and gas.

entry.title: Fraud, affordability and Trump policies drive friction in Minnesota Senate debate
entry.summary: The major party candidates for Minnesota's U.S. Senate seat faced off in an hourlong debate Friday on MPR News with fraud, affordability and fallout from the Trump administration's policies as key points of friction.

entry.title: Dozens of critically endangered orangutans rescued from Indonesian wildfires
entry.summary: Rescuers in Indonesia have saved dozens of orangutans from wildfires. The critically endangered species is fighting for their lives and habitats during this deadly wildfire season.
